name: pre-cr-suite-monorepo
description: Coverage-first pre-PR readiness workflow for VS Code and Neovim
author: Jakye Amos <jakyejobs@gmail.com>

scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:core && corepack pnpm run build:server && corepack pnpm run build:vscode
scripts.test:headless-beta: corepack pnpm run build:core && corepack pnpm run build:server && node scripts/smoke-headless-beta-gate.js
scripts.test:beta-parity: corepack pnpm run build:core && corepack pnpm run build:server && corepack pnpm run build:vscode && node scripts/smoke-cross-client-beta-parity.js
scripts.package: corepack pnpm run build && corepack pnpm --filter pre-cr-suite package
scripts.pre-pr: corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && node scripts/aios-adoption-gates.mjs validation
